mapper.select: SELECT id, activity_id, activity_name, strategy_id, begin_date_time, end_date_time, state, create_time, update_time FROM draw_activity WHERE activity_id = #{activityId}

SELECT id, strategy_id, award_id, award_name, award_desc, award_type, award_rate, level, inv_id, type, sort, create_time, update_time FROM draw_strategy_award WHERE strategy_id = #{strategyId} ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, strategy_id, count, weights, create_time, update_time FROM draw_strategy_weight WHERE strategy_id = #{strategyId} ORDER BY count ASC
SELECT award_id FROM draw_strategy_award WHERE strategy_id = #{strategyId} AND type = #{type} ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO draw_record (record_id, user_id, activity_id, strategy_id, award_id, award_name, award_desc, award_type, level, inv_id, state, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{recordId}, #{userId}, #{activityId}, #{strategyId}, #{awardId}, #{awardName}, #{awardDesc}, #{awardType}, #{level}, #{invId}, #{state}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
INSERT IGNORE INTO draw_record_detail (user_id, record_id, type, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{recordId}, #{type}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, activity_id, activity_name, strategy_id, begin_date_time, end_date_time, state, create_time, update_time FROM draw_activity ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, record_id, user_id, activity_id, strategy_id, award_id, award_name, award_desc, award_type, level, inv_id, state, create_time, update_time FROM draw_record WHERE record_id = #{recordId}
SELECT value FROM virtual_inventory_quota WHERE inv_id = #{invId} AND type = 'POINTS'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM draw_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND create_time >= CURDATE()

SELECT a.award_id AS awardId, a.award_name AS awardName, a.award_type AS awardType, a.level AS level, CASE WHEN a.award_type = 'VIRTUAL' AND vi.type = 'POINTS' THEN vi.value END AS pointsAmount, CASE WHEN a.inv_id = '0' OR COALESCE(vi.surplus_qty, q.surplus_qty) < 0 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(vi.surplus_qty, q.surplus_qty) END AS remaining, CASE WHEN a.inv_id = '0' OR COALESCE(vi.surplus_qty, q.surplus_qty) < 0 THEN NULL WHEN vi.inv_id IS NOT NULL THEN vi.surplus_qty + vi.issued_qty ELSE q.surplus_qty + q.waiting_qty + q.issued_qty END AS total FROM draw_strategy_award a LEFT JOIN virtual_inventory_quota vi ON vi.inv_id = a.inv_id LEFT JOIN physical_marketing_quota q ON q.inv_id = a.inv_id WHERE a.strategy_id = #{strategyId} ORDER BY a.sort ASC, a.id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM draw_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND award_type != 'THANKS'

SELECT r.record_id AS recordId, r.award_id AS awardId, r.award_name AS awardName, r.award_type AS awardType, r.level AS level, vi.value AS pointsAmount, r.create_time AS createTime FROM draw_record r LEFT JOIN virtual_inventory_quota vi ON vi.inv_id = r.inv_id AND vi.type = 'POINTS' WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.award_type != 'THANKS' ORDER BY r.create_time DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM draw_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND award_type != 'THANKS'
AND state IN #{s}
